name: Being Consistent
overview: Scripture calls believers to steadfastness in their work and faith, emphasizing wholehearted effort as seen in Ecclesiastes 9:10, which urges doing all tasks with might because opportunity ends with death. The consistency of Christ, who is unchanging 'yesterday, today, and forever' (Hebrews 13:8), provides the ultimate model for believers to imitate. Guarding against deception through worldly philosophies, as warned in Colossians 2:8, requires holding firmly to the eternal Word who was with God in the beginning and is God Himself (John 1:1). This unchanging foundation encourages a life marked by faithful perseverance and doctrinal integrity.
